faq.answer: I've built Apragya AI (AI agent builder with ERP, CRM and project management) and an AI chatbot and agent for InsureCRM that uses GPT-4o through an MCP server to score leads, clients and policies.
InsureCRM is an insurance CRM with an AI agent. It uses GPT-4o via MCP to choose the right tool and query the database, and it scores leads, clients and policies so agents know who to follow up with.
My core stack is Python and FastAPI for AI and backend work, Java and Spring Boot for REST APIs, PHP and Laravel for web apps, and MySQL, with Git, GitHub Actions and CI/CD on top.
I have about 2.5 years of experience as an Associate Software Developer at Fronseye Tech Pvt Ltd, since March 2024, building AI-native backend systems and business applications.
You can email me at diwakarvwork@gmail.com or message me on LinkedIn using the links at the bottom of this page.
I completed a B.E. in Computer Science and Engineering from Panimalar Engineering College, Chennai, from 2019 to 2023, with a CGPA of 8.7 out of 10.
